opennyai_summary.decision:
By order dated 16.08.2024, he has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for fourteen years, to pay a fine of Rs. 20,000/- and in default of payment of fine, to Patna High Court CR.
Since a prayer for suspension of sentence has been made in the memo of appeal, Mr. Binod Bihari Singh, the learned APP shall put in his written objection by the next date.
